Titel: Senior PMO Lead SAP S/4HANA Transformation (Remote, EU)
Unternehmen: Duna Arc Consulting Kft.
Ort: Budapest (Ungarn)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4187455290/
Abgerufen am: 07.09.2026 06:55

About the job
Duna Arc Consulting is a nearshore delivery partner for SAP programmes of mid-sized European manufacturers. For a multi-country S/4HANA transformation we are looking for a Senior PMO Lead on a freelance basis.

What you will do
Set up and run the programme management office for five workstreams
Maintain the integrated plan, the RAID log and the change request process
Prepare steering committee packs and weekly status reporting for the client CFO
Track budget, resource plans and consultant timesheets
Align release planning with the SAP Activate phases

What you bring
7+ years in PMO roles, at least two of them on SAP S/4HANA programmes
Strong command of MS Project, Jira and Power BI
Excellent English; German is a plus but not required
PRINCE2 or PMP certification preferred

Terms
Freelance contract with our Hungarian entity, daily rate 620 EUR
100 % remote; you must be resident in an EU country other than Germany for tax and contractual reasons
Occasional travel to Budapest (max. 2 days per quarter)
Start October 2026, 12 months
